manifest.name: mode_paint
manifest.tests: paint strokes at 3 widths: width fidelity, bristle lanes, edge crispness on a toned ground

manifest.name: mode_scumble
manifest.tests: dry-brush scumble over a ridged paint patch: catches ridges only, leaves bare ground alone

manifest.name: mode_smudge
manifest.tests: smudge drags wet blue into yellow and decays; flattens relief

manifest.name: mode_glaze
manifest.tests: glaze: thin transparent tint, colour shifts but no relief is added

manifest.name: dabs
manifest.tests: short dabs, aspect 1.2-3.5: silhouette shape (faceting), bristle texture on small marks

manifest.name: dry_tail
manifest.tests: strokes running out of paint: coverage falls along the stroke, tail breaks into bristle gaps

manifest.name: long_straight
manifest.tests: long straight strokes at 3 widths: edge raggedness, width constancy, hairlines at the edges

manifest.name: blend_wet_in_wet
manifest.tests: blue over wet yellow at pick-up 0.12/0.30/0.60: overlap colour must lie on the pigment mixing curve (green), not grey

manifest.name: long_curved
manifest.tests: long arcs at 3 curvatures: edge kinks at polyline joins, width constancy

manifest.name: blend_wet_on_dry
manifest.tests: blue over DRY yellow (dry_after): no mixing, crisp overlap; contrast with wet-in-wet

manifest.name: blend_complementary
manifest.tests: orange/blue and violet/yellow wet-in-wet: chroma of the overlap vs the pigment mixing curve

manifest.name: mud_stack
manifest.tests: alternating complementary strokes 2/4/6/8 deep: how fast overpainting turns to mud

manifest.name: gradient
manifest.tests: overlapping strokes through a colour ramp: banding, hairlines inside a smooth passage

manifest.name: strata_sky
manifest.tests: rows of long overlapping strokes with the Storm Light sky style: height steps at stroke edges give dark hairlines under raking light

manifest.name: cylinder
manifest.tests: vertical strokes shaded as a cylinder: form must stay readable under the relief lighting

manifest.name: sphere
manifest.tests: contour-following arcs shaded as a sphere: form readability, relief must not break the shading

manifest.name: pile_up
manifest.tests: 16 strokes over the same place: paint height must stay bounded (flatten)
